ops.body:
Fixed in capt-hook 8.18.0 (PyPI live, wave b1fafa07..d26e4ada on main).

Mechanism: `SessionSlot.mutate()` — a FileLock-guarded get→yield→set contextmanager ported up from DurableSlot (f95a4e1d) — now wraps EVERY session-state write: HookState fire accounting, PrimitiveState.consumed dedup, last_fired_at, echo fields, SeenKeys. max_fires became reserve-then-release in dispatch: the slot is reserved under lock BEFORE the handler (losers skip the handler entirely — no side effects, no LLM spend), released under a second lock if the handler returns falsy or raises (including BaseException/SystemExit, 89dc072e). llm_evaluate is now read-only; consume_signals' locked re-match is the authoritative claim and an empty re-match aborts the fire (e2531bb9 — closes the LLM double-fire race codex found).

Evidence: red-first delivered-count test failed 20-delivered vs max_fires=3 pre-fix, exactly 3 post-fix (tests/test_state_race.py); 20-thread no-lost-update tests on HookState + PrimitiveState.consumed; bounded 4-subprocess stress scenario f19 fire-race (3 of 4 delivered, fire_count==3, all exit 0).

Accepted residuals (documented, not bugs to reopen): SIGKILL between reserve and release leaks the slot for that session (no lease machinery; per-session bounded); a falsy handler's reservation can suppress a concurrent sibling in the same burst (under-fire is the chosen failure direction for a throttle); session_id-less payloads keep null-store semantics (no cap enforcement — pre-existing by design); duplicate handler names share one budget (pre-existing fn.__name__ registration).
